name: test-time-compute-allocation-v2
description: With the model frozen, how should a fixed test-time compute budget be spent? Compare allocation strategies at matched cost on a fixed task suite with an automatic verifier: more independent samples with majority voting, longer single chains of thought, verifier-guided reranking of a candidate pool, and adaptive allocation that spends more only on items the model is uncertain about. Which strategy buys the most accuracy per unit of compute, and where does each one saturate?

constraints.frozen_base_model: exactly one open-weights model, at most 8B parameters, fp16 on a single A100-40GB; never trained or fine-tuned
constraints.automatic_verifier_required: scoring is automatic with no LLM judge: GSM8K and MATH exact-match on the final answer, HumanEval unit-test execution
constraints.off_the_shelf_benchmarks_only: task suites load directly through HuggingFace datasets, with no bespoke harness, simulator or external service
constraints.compute_matched_comparison: every strategy comparison is made at matched total sampled tokens; an accuracy gain bought purely by spending more compute is not a result, it is the null hypothesis
constraints.cost_axis_mandatory: each run records total sampled tokens, wall-clock latency and peak memory alongside accuracy; accuracy without a cost number is an incomplete result
constraints.baseline_is_single_greedy_pass: the mandatory baseline is a single greedy pass of the same model on the same items on this hardware
constraints.saturation_must_be_measured: each strategy is swept across at least three budget levels so the saturation point is measured rather than asserted
constraints.seeds: at least 3 seeds for any sampled decoding; greedy runs record that decoding is deterministic instead of faking seed variance
constraints.numeric_metrics_mandatory: every run persists real numeric accuracy and real numeric cost values; a run whose metric artifacts carry empty values is a failed run, not a completed one
constraints.negative_results_in_scope: finding that no strategy beats the compute-matched baseline is a valid, reportable outcome
constraints.model_generation_currency: base model must be a CURRENT-generation open-weights model verified to exist on the configured HuggingFace endpoint on 2026-08-04: Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B (29.7M downloads), Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B, or Qwen/Qwen3-8B. Qwen2.5, TinyLlama and any pre-Qwen3 generation are explicitly forbidden, including the values hardcoded in agents/experiment_forge.py. If a plan names a model, it must state the date and endpoint on which that model's existence was verified.

out_of_scope: training, fine-tuning, RLHF or distillation of the base model
benchmarks requiring a dedicated agent harness, sandbox or simulator (GAIA, SWE-bench, WebArena, ALFWorld and similar)
LLM-as-judge scoring for the primary metric
models above 8B parameters or multi-GPU sharding of one model
comparisons that are not matched on inference cost
claims resting on numbers copied from papers rather than measured on this hardware
using a superseded model generation (Qwen2.5-*, TinyLlama-*, google/vit-base-*) or any model whose current existence was not verified against a live registry
